root_causes.finding: AA0 payload/base-independent assurance is conceptually PIP-scoped but live tests.yml gates it behind VIT routing/placement preflight; placement faults therefore suppress independent payload evidence.
root_causes.minimal_correction: Make PIP identity/AA0 validation an earlier independent assurance plane. VIT placement consumes AA0 receipt rather than blocking its production.

root_causes.finding: Authoritative VIT lineage is currently extracted from mutable PR body text.
root_causes.minimal_correction: Persist content-addressed lineage/admission artifacts; PR body may display immutable IDs only.

root_causes.finding: GitHub success/failure/skipped is used as a proxy for assurance meaning; upstream blockage can appear as packet/test failure.
root_causes.minimal_correction: Introduce typed assurance states and one deterministic presentation mapping. Required admission consumes typed records, not raw conclusion strings.

root_causes.finding: SIQ selects latest same-named check runs on a head SHA, so reruns can silently change the evidence set used for admission.
root_causes.minimal_correction: Create immutable IntegrationAssuranceGeneration / IntegrationAdmissionReceipt pinning PIP, placement, result tree, GRT proof, policy generation and exact workflow/check evidence IDs.
proposed_surfaces: new assurance generation/receipt schema and runtime

root_causes.finding: Placement-only invalidation semantics exist but the operational path frequently reconstructs branches/PRs and broad assurance instead of actuating recomposition/selective renewal.
root_causes.minimal_correction: Wire PLACEMENT_RECOMPUTE_ONLY and ASSURANCE_RENEWAL_REQUIRED to a bounded recovery executor that retains PIP/AA0 and renews only affected placement/GRT planes.

evidence: #1098 implementation candidate vs evidence-bearing final head
root_causes.finding: Adding gate/QA/programme-state closeout after candidate qualification can create a second base-sensitive tree and repeat full assurance.
root_causes.minimal_correction: Include precomputable closeout intent in PIP logical transaction; bind post-write-only facts through PhysicalMaterialisationReceipt/PacketCompletionReceipt.

root_causes.finding: Build-ahead is commonly represented as stacked Git branch ancestry, delaying qualification and expanding invalidation radius.
root_causes.minimal_correction: Represent successor dependencies with typed PacketPredecessorRequirement/PIP DAG and VIT prospective composition; treat branches as disposable construction workspaces.

root_causes.finding: PR/materialisation creation can duplicate semantic work.
root_causes.minimal_correction: Require semantic idempotency key (programme_id, packet_id, pip_id or transaction_id) before creating transport; resolve existing demand first.

root_causes.finding: External compare API failure can block otherwise reproducible Git ancestry.
root_causes.minimal_correction: Use exact Git object/graph proof as normative; API remains discovery/convenience. Missing/unverified Git objects still fail closed.

proposed_migration_order.name: ASSURANCE_SEPARATION_SHADOW
proposed_migration_order.changes: Add immutable typed assurance objects and reorder only in shadow/dual-evaluation mode; live admission unchanged.

proposed_migration_order.name: IMMUTABLE_LINEAGE_DUAL_READ
proposed_migration_order.changes: Produce immutable lineage/admission artifacts while live preflight still accepts current PR-body lineage; compare exact decisions.

proposed_migration_order.name: RECOVERY_ACTUATOR_SHADOW
proposed_migration_order.changes: Actuate placement recompute/selective renewal in shadow for main-movement cases; no physical write.

proposed_migration_order.name: IDEMPOTENCY_AND_CLOSEOUT_SHADOW
proposed_migration_order.changes: Exercise semantic dispatch keys and non-churning completion receipts against historical/live-shadow packets.

proposed_migration_order.name: LIVE_CUTOVER_CANDIDATE
proposed_migration_order.changes: Only under a separately operator-approved remediation plan, switch required admission to immutable receipt and typed assurance; preserve existing ruleset perimeter and serialized physical writer.

compatibility_risks.mitigation: Fail closed; keep current live route authoritative until deterministic equivalence is demonstrated.

compatibility_risks.risk: Typed assurance mapping accidentally weakens a required check
compatibility_risks.mitigation: Required assertion can contribute only explicit PASS; BLOCKED_UPSTREAM/NA/STALE never satisfy admission.

compatibility_risks.risk: Placement recovery reuses stale payload evidence
compatibility_risks.mitigation: Reuse only when PIP, harness, dependency and authority frontiers prove unchanged; otherwise escalate invalidation.
Content-addressed receipt resolver indexed by semantic transaction and physical commit/tree.

compatibility_risks.risk: Git-native ancestry proof uses incomplete object set
compatibility_risks.mitigation: Require exact fetch/object availability and fail closed if ancestry cannot be reproduced.

rollback: Every proposed stage is forward-disablable. Before live cutover the existing required check, current VIT/SIQ/GRT route and ruleset remain authoritative. A future cutover packet must define an exact rollback to the prior admission verifier without deleting new evidence generations.
non_changes: OVC merge readiness required context until separate cutover
